matching: Magnitude of each local MS-bar coefficient at its own pole threshold; diagnostic only. FPS V=-m² H†H/2+λ(H†H)² and m²=2μ_H²; μ_H²=M_h²/2 only at tree level at low scale.
weak_matter: Two zero-hypercharge Majorana triplets, no other new weak non-singlets between reference and the two poles. Two Dirac down singlets have b2=0.
budget: Illustrative no-cancellation ceiling equal to the high end of the reference Higgs mass squared. Not an adopted cognitive axiom nor a statistical exclusion.
